documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported a strong Q2 FY27 performance with revenue from operations up 16% year-on-year to INR682 crores and significant improvements in profitability and margins. Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% and EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range, supported by a growing non-GPL business, robust CDMO traction, and new product launches. The company also highlighted ongoing expansion plans, including the Solapur facility and Taloja R&D center, alongside a debt-free balance sheet and strong cash generation. Alivus Life reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹6,820 million, representing a 16.0% YoY growth driven by healthy demand across key markets and robust non-GPL performance. Gross margin expanded to 64.4% and EBITDA margin reached 41.8% due to a favorable product mix and improved operational efficiencies.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: The CDMO business is targeted to double from its current size in the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time, which would effectively contribute to about between 12% to 15% of the overall revenues is how we are looking at the CDMO business.

guidance.claim: Management stated that its ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline provide confidence in sustaining growth momentum.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

guidance.claim: Alivus Life Sciences guided for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27, with growth expected to be higher in H2 FY27.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain EBITDA margins in the range of 30% to 32%.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: The company expects to incur capex of approximately INR 540 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects its steady-state R&D expenditure to end up around 4% of revenue.
guidance.quote: So we should sort of end up at a steady state of around 4%.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth was driven by new product launches and healthy demand across the existing portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: During quarter 2, revenue from operations stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and a healthy demand across our existing portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Performance remains healthy across Europe, Japan, North America, LATAM, and ROW markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Performance remains healthy across Europe, Japan, North America, LATAM and ROW markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Healthy demand trends and enhanced visibility for H2 FY27 provide confidence in sustaining the growth trajectory.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, healthy demand trends and enhanced visibility for H2 FY27 provide us with confidence in sustaining our growth trajectory through the remainder of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The pricing environment in the generic business is quite stable with a regular level of erosion.
demand_outlook.quote: So the pricing environment, I would say, is quite stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 16.0% YoY supported by healthy demand across key markets and contributions from recent product launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business grew by 26.5% year-on-year during Q1 FY27 driven by new product launches and strong demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business growth is expected to remain flattish in FY27 with stronger performance in H2.
demand_outlook.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

demand_outlook.claim: The company recorded broad-based geographical growth across all markets during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Geographically, we saw broad-based growth across all markets during the quarter, highlighting the strength of the diversified business.

demand_outlook.claim: CDMO segment momentum is expected to increase in the second half of the year from new projects.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we can expect the segment to gain momentum in the second half of the year, supported by contributions from newly added projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The Solapur facility Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja is progressing well and is expected on schedule early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D facility in Taloja is advancing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of new R&D facility at Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is advancing as planned

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur facility operation is delayed slightly and is now expected to be operational in early Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the Taloja R&D center has commenced and is progressing on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 85 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity addition underway is 160KL for Dahej and 110KL for Ankleshwar.
capex_expansion.quote: So Dahej is getting 160KL and Ankleshwar is getting like 110KL.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding onetime income, the adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs experienced price inflation, but the company has largely been able to pass it on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Nitin, we have had a price inflation on our raw materials. But largely speaking, we've been able to pass it on to the customers.

margins_costs.claim: Solvent prices driven by crude are noted as a potential cost headwind.
margins_costs.quote: Where there are headwinds is on the prices of solvents that are driven by crude.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Margin reached 64.4%, up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY due to a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin increased to 28.9%, up 390 bps QoQ and 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved by 510 basis points year-on-year to 60.2% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have increased, and the company managed to pass on a part of it to customers.
margins_costs.quote: So there has been an increase in raw material prices. It's not been very steep and we have managed to pass on a part of it to our customers.

margins_costs.claim: R&D expenditure for Q1 FY27 was INR 24 crores, representing 3.7% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: R&D expenditure for Q1 FY '27 was INR24 crores, which was 3.7% of our sales.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as of September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio has 30 new products in the active grid representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Of the high potent portfolio products, 14 have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages, and 9 are progressing through lab development.
orders_capacity.quote: Of these, 14 products have been validated, 7 are in advanced stages of development, and the remaining 9 products are progressing through lab development.

orders_capacity.claim: Non-GPL business generated 79% of overall company revenue during Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Non-GPL business now contributes 79% of our overall revenues.

orders_capacity.claim: Fixed asset turnover ratio remained above 2x at 2.1 times despite ongoing capital expenditure.
orders_capacity.quote: FATR is 2.1 times – Asset turns remained above 2x despite the impact of the ongoing capex cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: The company had 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid representing an $82 billion total addressable market.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is working on 7 new CDMO inquiries while current revenue comes from 5 active projects.
orders_capacity.quote: One second, I talked about 7 new inquiries that we are working on. The current revenue is coming out of 5 projects, okay?

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to remain a net debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on Invested Capital Employed expanded to approximately 34%.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated a free cash flow of INR 90 crores, bringing cash and cash equivalents to INR 880 crores as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus Life Sciences continues to remain a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that capacity is not a growth challenge and the company will not spend money to acquire basic manufacturing facilities.
capital_allocation.quote: See, capacity is not a challenge for the growth at Alivus, okay?

risks_headwinds.claim: The global situation impacted by the Middle East conflict has the potential to affect freight and logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes. So see, this global situation that is getting impacted by the Middle East conflict, okay, has the potential to -- I mean, freight is one issue, but really freight doesn't even if freight has gone up, but it hasn't significantly impacted us.

risks_headwinds.claim: GPL business declined 52.6% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 due to inventory rationalization.
risks_headwinds.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited the ongoing war situation and its impact on raw material prices as a risk causing caution on guidance.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja is hoped to be on schedule early next year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

management_commitments.claim: The company reiterates its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
management_commitments.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

management_commitments.claim: Management is confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to build a portfolio of around 25-30 dossiers developed in the next 3 years through its newly acquired formulation CRO.
management_commitments.quote: So, we will be building -- we've already identified a portfolio of around 25-30 dossiers that would be developed in the next 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Brownfield API and intermediate expansion of approximately 100KL capacity at Ankleshwar is planned for operational completion in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Brownfield API capacity expansion of approximately 160KL at Dahej is scheduled for completion in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Brownfield API Dahej Planned addition of ~160KL Capacity Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 greenfield expansion at Solapur adding ~340 KL capacity for intermediate block and backward integration is planned for Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 1 - ~340 KL (Intermediate block and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 greenfield expansion at Solapur adding ~125 KL capacity for API and pharma block is planned for Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 2 - ~125 KL (API / Pharma block) Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Phase 3 greenfield addition of ~535 KL capacity at Solapur is planned for FY29.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 3 - Planned addition of ~535 KL FY29

management_commitments.claim: Alivus Life Sciences guided for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The Solapur expansion will become operational in early Q3 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to incur approximately INR 540 crores in capex during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
